title: Pricing: Forecast & Billing

freshness.note: options reused from upkeep-pricing-smart-upkeep-pricing (split, not new)

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Pricing Page: Tier mix planning Assumption, use base mix (30/55/15) or Conservative (45/45/10)?

optionA.label: Base 30/55/15
optionA.desc: Blended tier about $167/mo in the Oct 14 forecast.

pairs.ask_old: Tier Mix Planning Assumption: Use Base Mix (30/55/15) Or Conservative (45/45/10)?

pairs.ask: Attach-Rate Logging: Treat App Add-On Events As Source Of Truth, Or Keep Research Assumptions Until 50 Members?

optionA.label: App Events As Truth
optionA.desc: Forecast says replace assumptions with beta data.

optionB.label: Assumptions Until 50
optionB.desc: Too noisy early; revisit at 50 members.

pairs.ask: Failed Card Recovery: Stripe Smart Retries From Day One (docs cite ~55% recovery), Or Manual Follow-Up?

optionA.label: Smart Retries From Day One
optionA.desc: Pause scheduling while recovering; do not silent-cancel.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Pricing Page: Complete vs plus Gap, complete is about 1.9x plus ($312 vs $164); narrow the Gap, or keep it?

optionA.label: Keep The Gap
optionA.desc: Complete stays premium for monthly-visit buyers.

optionB.label: Narrow Toward 1.4x
optionB.desc: May lift Complete share closer to ~21% camera-study top option.

pairs.ask_old: Complete Vs Plus Gap: Complete Is About 1.9x Plus ($312 vs $164). Narrow The Gap, Or Keep It?

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Pricing Page: Handoff, share this forecast with UpKeep now, or hold for an edit pass first?

optionA.label: Send To UpKeep Now
optionA.desc: They own pricing on smartupkeep.ai; research is ready.

optionB.label: Hold For Edit
optionB.desc: Tighten assumptions before it hits their board.

pairs.ask_old: Share This Forecast With UpKeep Now, Or Hold For An Edit Pass First?

pairs.ask: Average Member Spend Model: Plan Cash On Base ~$228/mo, Or Conservative ~$189/mo?

optionA.label: Base ~$228/mo
optionA.desc: Tier blend + add-on attach from Oct 14 forecast.

optionB.label: Conservative ~$189/mo
optionB.desc: Safer until beta attach rates replace assumptions.

pairs.ask: Essentials Floor: Hold $99/mo From Price, Or Raise For Metro Detroit Cost?

optionA.label: Hold $99 From
optionA.desc: Conservative; matches draft pricing-config on the box.

optionB.label: Raise The Floor
optionB.desc: Typical 2-3k sq ft homes quote higher than From.

pairs.ask: Annual Prepay: Offer Two Months Free For Paying A Year Up Front, Or Monthly Billing Only?

optionA.label: Two Months Free Yearly
optionA.desc: Pay 10, get 12; cash up front and fewer cancels mid-year.

pairs.ask: Smart Upkeep Pricing Page: Bank payments, add ACH Debit (Stripe 0.8%, capped at $5), or cards only, (stripe.com/pricing).

optionA.label: Add ACH Debit
optionA.desc: About $1.31 fee on $164 vs about $5 on a card; fewer expired-card failures.

optionB.label: Cards Only
optionB.desc: One payment method to support; higher fees.

pairs.ask_old: Bank Payments: Add ACH Debit (Stripe 0.8%, capped at $5), Or Cards Only? (stripe.com/pricing)

pairs.ask: Founding Member Price: Lock It For 12 Months, Or Allow A Yearly Increase From Day One?

optionA.label: Lock For 12 Months
optionA.desc: Easy promise for beta friends and family; revisit at renewal.

optionB.label: Yearly Increase Allowed
optionB.desc: Terms let you raise prices each year (for example with costs).
